text:
deploy-bot: RELEASE CHECK: release-id=2026.3.5 -> promotion blocked: prod/staging serviceAccount annotation mismatch detected. Keys differ: 'tls-certname' present in staging, missing in prod; 'imagePullSecret' value empty in prod. See /checks/env-parity/serviceAccountAnnotations.

sam: ack, saw the alert. I think this came from the chart-values refactor in #428 — we removed default annotations in prod overlay.

maria: looking through the helmrelease history now, pulling the last successful staging values. will report if it was an intentional change. :eyes:

dinesh: quick question — can we hotfix by pinning the deployment image to the previous tag and backfilling annotations later? pin -> rollback-ish semantics.

ops-oncall: we should be careful. pinning image avoids new code but does not solve the missing tls-certname which affects cert rotation job and probe. That job will fail on startup in prod. Recommend not promoting until annotations restored or automated fallback in place.

release-coordinator: change window ends in 22m. If we can't get parity in 15m we need to abort and roll back the canary. What's the minimal change to restore parity quickly?

sam: minimal path: 1) add annotation to serviceAccount in prod (k8s patch), 2) re-run deploybot preflight checks, 3) promote. I'll prepare the kubectl commands.

sam: ```
# patch prod service account with tls-certname and imagePullSecret
kubectl --context=prod -n inference patch serviceaccount inference-svc -p '{"metadata": {"annotations": {"tls-certname": "inference.redwood.ai"}}}'
kubectl --context=prod -n inference patch secret reg-creds --type=merge -p '{"data": {".dockerconfigjson": "<redacted-base64>"}}'
```

maria: created branch hotfix/prod-sa-annotations and applying the helm override: `helm upgrade inference ./charts/inference --namespace inference --set serviceAccount.annotations.tls-certname=inference.redwood.ai --reuse-values` Applying now to prod canary subset first.

dinesh: if helm patch doesn't land in time we can run the `kubectl patch` as emergency. I'll stand by to execute if needed.

ops-oncall: please also note: k8s admission webhook rejects missing certname on nodes with strict policy. If manual patch, check `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` after to confirm cert-init containers succeed.

release-coordinator: decision? We have 14m left. If hotfix lands to canary in 8m and all green -> promote. Otherwise we'll abort and schedule rollback for full window at 09:30 UTC.

sam: hotfix applied to canary, preflight running. deploy-bot posted updated check: preflight passed for canary, staging/prod annotation keys now match. :thumbsup:

maria: rolling promotion in 2m, creating release note: "Hotfix: restore serviceAccount annotations (tls-certname, imagePullSecret) for prod to match staging; prevented cert-init failures during rollout."

ops-oncall: watching logs for cert-init and image pull. so far so good.

dinesh: leaving a follow-up task to add unit test in our release-checks to catch removed annotations: infra#512.

release-coordinator: promoted. leaving postmortem ticket to explain root cause and owner for chart-values refactor. tagging @platform for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
